0022600109.text: The Spurs (0-2) are still looking for their first win after two losses, sitting 12th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, while the Mavericks (1-1) are 9th in the West, 1 game back in the Southwest, and coming off a win. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision, while Dallas is missing Cooper Flagg (out, shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), with Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Spurs won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
